intent: Ten engineering tasks start with five explicit simulated condition records: fold-only, fold plus gap/paper/objects, and gap-only. Learners select every changed field before deciding whether the comparison isolates the intended fold question. Later tasks retain per-trial safety, two-design inference limits, repeated comparison, failed attempts and performance records. Fresh paper-tower transfer names three versions A/B/C, changes the studied factor and exposes partly correct reporting plans.
picturePurpose: Exact code condition cards show which variables changed; no invented load measurements, geometry, performance curve or generated physical demonstration is needed. These simulated comparisons are labelled separately from the original report.

transfer.stem: Which plan follows the fair-test and reporting limits?
transfer.passage:
A FICTIONAL PAPER-TOWER TEST
A team tests three classroom paper-tower versions: A, B and C. A is shorter with a narrow base. B is taller with a wide base. C is taller with the same narrow base as A. The paper kind and test objects are the same for all three. When comparing A with B, both the height and the base width change. Comparing A with C changes height but keeps base width the same. A teacher supervises both comparisons. The report keeps a failed attempt and explains the later choice. Only these three classroom versions have been tested; the team does not claim to have found the strongest tower possible.

options.text: Compare A with C to study height, record the failed attempt, and limit the finding to these tested versions.
Compare A with C to study height, then claim the strongest possible tower and remove the failed attempt.
Record the failed attempt, but compare A with B and attribute the whole difference to height alone.

answer.display: Compare A with C to study height, record the failed attempt, and limit the finding to these tested versions.

explanation.strategy: 先检查是否只改变要比较的那一项，再检查报告是否保留失败记录与测试范围。

steps.text: 比较高度，应选A与C：底宽相同，高度不同。
steps.reason: A与B同时改变高度和底宽，不能把全部差别只归给高度；A与C的底宽、纸张和测试物相同。

steps.text: 保留失败尝试，并把结论限定在已测试的三个课堂版本。
steps.reason: 三个版本分别是A、B、C；失败记录解释后面的选择。测过这些版本，仍不能声称找到了所有可能设计中最强的一种。

distractors.reason: 选A与C比较高度这一半正确，却删掉失败记录，还把有限测试扩大成所有可能设计的最强结论。
保留失败记录这一半正确，却选了同时改变高度和底宽的A与B，还把全部差别只归给高度。

explanation.pitfall: 公平比较要对准研究问题；只改一项不等于什么都能比较，只测两种也不等于证明最强。

visual.title: 公平比较，保留记录与范围
visual.caption: A与C只改高度；A与B改了高度和底宽。保留失败记录，结论不夸到所有可能设计。

explanation.transfer: 如果另一次只改变底宽而高度不变，那次试验能直接回答哪项设计因素的问题？为什么不能称为比较两种高度？
